title: Malicious code in react-native-datepickerror (npm)
description: The npm package react-native-datepickerror version 99.9.1 is a typosquatting malicious package that installs attacker-controlled code. It contains an empty index.js but declares a dependency as a direct tarball URL hosted on Google Cloud Storage, which is fetched and executed without integrity checks or version pinning. This allows the bucket owner to execute arbitrary code during installation. The package name closely resembles the legitimate react-native-datepicker package, likely to trick users into installing it.
